name: KDA
notes: Kimi Delta Attention (gated delta-rule with PER-CHANNEL log-decay) NKI kernels, vendored verbatim (Apache-2.0, ./LICENSE) from jburtoft/kda-neuron-kernels (HuggingFace build/torch-neuron/): nki_kda.py + nki_kda_chunked_exact.py. Two on-device-validated variants selected via the module attr kda_mode: 'prefill' -> kda_chunk_step_exact (exact per-channel 128-chunk, cross-chunk state carry), 'decode' -> kda_recurrent_fwd_state (token-serial). Per-(batch,head) op; caller loops B*H, does fla-core q/k L2-norm+scale (adapter handles preprocess). Constraints: head_dim==128, chunk==128, prefill seqlen % 128 == 0, fp32 gate path. On-device validated on trn2 (nki 0.6.0): cos 1.0, max_err ~1e-7 (prefill, all gate regimes incl g=2.0) / ~1e-8 (decode); exact state carry. Injected via backends.kernel_inject through adapter:build_kda_forward.
